Name: ThinkingTime - Auto Pause When Idle
Author: PokeBenji
Description:
[b]ThinkingTime[/b]! Time only moves when you do, just like in [b]SUPERHOT[/b]. Call it AFK protection, accessibility, cheating, or just a better way to think before you act.

[b]Version 2.0[/b] is rewritten from scratch for Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4+. Time flow is now based on the player’s actual animations, not held keys. If your farmer is moving, using a tool, eating, emoting, charging, jumping, or otherwise animating, time flows. When the farmer is truly idle, the valley pauses.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Animation-Based Time Control: Time pauses when your farmer is idle and resumes while the farmer is actively animating.[/*]
[*]Configurable Pause Delay: Add a delay in milliseconds before time pauses again after an animation ends.[/*]
[*]HUD Indicator: Shows a visual cue over the clock while time is paused.[/*]
[*]Safety First: Prevents player damage while paused.[/*]
[*]Frozen World Systems: Can freeze NPCs, monsters, farm animals, buff timers, and optional world animations.[/*]
[*]Customizable: Configure settings in Generic Mod Config Menu or edit config.json manually.[/*]
[*]Clock Mod Compatibility: No longer uses the old negative clock interval method, improving compatibility with mods like RealClock.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configuration Options[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable or disable the mod[/*]
[*]Toggle key[/*]
[*]Pause delay[/*]
[*]Flow during menus[/*]
[*]Flow during events and minigames[/*]
[*]Freeze NPCs and monsters[/*]
[*]Freeze farm animals[/*]
[*]Freeze buff timers[/*]
[*]Freeze world animations[/*]
[*]Prevent damage while paused[/*]
[*]Show paused clock indicator[/*]
[*]Show debug reason[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI: https://smapi.io/[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the mod files.[/*]
[*]Place the ThinkingTime folder into your Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
- Mobile compatibility is not currently guaranteed for this rewrite.
